notes.title: THE LONG AWAITED NEW MAP IS HERE!
notes.notes: [h3]The time has come. The Hollowgate Mansion is already here along with a lot of additions to the game. Been a while, right? Now let's dive deep into it.[/h3][p][/p][h1]THE HOLLOWGATE MANSION[/h1][p][/p][h3]The new map introduces new ways to interact with the ghost and a completely different escape route. You’ll need to uncover the mystery surrounding the entity - and above all, stay alert. Every move you make is being watched. You are never truly alone… it’s always watching.[/h3][h3][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="https://i.postimg.cc/QCkSpPrR/anounce1.png"][/img][/p][h3]Unlike other maps, [b]The Hollowgate Mansion[/b] is set in a cold, snowy environment with a frosty atmosphere.[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="https://i.postimg.cc/Hns39zsn/IMG-9507.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://i.postimg.cc/dVHkxKmJ/anounce3.png"][/img][/p][h3]The new map includes lots of new interactions with the environment, items, challenging puzzles, and terrifying ghost behaviors to prevent your way out. The escape route is different this time - but you’ll have to discover it by yourself.[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="https://i.postimg.cc/7Y6rH8rC/IMG-9505.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Team up with your friends and uncover the mystery behind the entity. Fulfill her needs, and she may choose to aid you.[/h3][p][/p][h3][img src="https://i.postimg.cc/MTgDBQrf/IMG-9508.jpg"][/img][/h3][h3]The Hollowgate Mansion is filled with horror and mystery. It’s up to you to find the strength and courage to escape. Whether alone or with friends, never forget - it watches your every step.[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="https://i.postimg.cc/NFL3sm2y/IMG-9509.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h1]FIXES AND CHANGES[/h1][p][/p][h3]Hundreds - if not thousands of bugs and issues have been fixed. Honestly, I’ve lost count, but here are some of the most notable changes:[/h3][p][/p][h3][b]\[CHANGED][/b][/h3][list][*][p]Simplified the Beaver Street House note puzzle (the note with keypad digits will directly spawn near PC instead of behind of the wall picture.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased max stamina cap[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted lightning performance [/p][/*][*][p]Increased Ghost move speed on all difficulties[/p][/*][*][p]Added "safe time" during interactions with some of objectives during which hunt cannot be triggered[/p][/*][*][p]Increased a whole difficulty of game (adjusted hunt timings, events frequency and other), but to make it balanced the Auto-Injector has more charges (was 2, now 5) to bring back fallen teammates. This change will make it more forgiving for players to not sit in spectate view for too long[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased chance for light to shutdown[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted audio sources to make sounding more natural[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]\[FIXED][/b][/h3][list][*][p]The dark screen while in spectate view[/p][/*][*][p]The occurrence when you cannot pick up an item under a car (usually happens when you try to take Car Jack under the car and replacing places with item in hands)[/p][/*][*][p]Lobby connection problem[/p][/*][*][p]Ghost animations and speed were not synchronized[/p][/*][*][p]While inviting a friend in lobby, you could trigger ingame buttons while in Steam overlay[/p][/*][*][p]Some clipping through walls and stuck occurrences [/p][/*][*][p]Some item descriptions had grammar errors [/p][/*][/list][h2][/h2][h2]DEVELOPER NOTE[/h2][p][/p][p][i]Hey everyone, I just want to thank you for your patience. I’ve poured my heart and soul into this new map, doing my best to make it stand out and give you the experience you’ll truly enjoy with your friends. The journey wasn't easy, but never once I lost motivation to work on The Escape: Together.[/i][/p][p][i]I’m grateful to have such a wonderful community - seeing you play, share comments and reviews, laugh and scream together brings me real joy. Thank you for being a part of this.[/i][/p][p][b][i]- Tim aka chloeprice[/i][/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Huge performance boost & New Feedback system!
notes.notes:
Hey there! Here's a new update which brings a new Feedback system along with performance issues fixes. Let's get to it!

[h1]A BIG PERFORMANCE UPDATE[/h1]

A new system has been implemented to decrease GPU/CPU load. As of now, the objects that are in a con of view, but are behind walls/or any other obstacle will not render. This leads to a more smooth gameplay as well as FPS boost.

Here's a demonstration:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5jd8Mvi.gif[/img]

[h1]NEW FEEDBACK SYSTEM[/h1]

Now you can easily share your feedback! You can report any found bugs via main menu, and you also can share your gameplay experience after completing/failing a map.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/RNYWBu0.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/9JRU4ch.png[/img]

The discord button link has also been added to main menu. 

Currently I'm working on known issues. This fix will drop already this week. Don't forget to share your feedback to make this game even better! As always, thanks for your contribution.

notes.title: NEW MAP IS HERE!
notes.notes:
[h1]Beaver Street House[/h1]

As I'm marking my birthday, I'm super excited to introduce you the new map - [b]Beaver Street House[/b].
This map takes up to 3 players. Beware, a new entity is here to stalk you.  

As always, a new map has a lot of new items, puzzles and some other stuff which I will describe below. Let's roll!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/b8GCjZ1.png[/img]

[h1] A New Ghost [/h1]

As usual, a new entity comes along with a new map with updated behaviour and improved AI script.
Let's talk about some of the new ghost possibilities:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8nf3Jvr.png[/img]

[h3]Poltergeist behaviour[/h3]

As many requested, the entity can now interact with surrounding items. If you hear a vase dropping behind your back, it's near.

[h3]The more it goes, the harder it gets[/h3]
The game had a system that with every hunt the ghost becomes stronger, and now this feature has evolved. Now, after a certain amount of ghost interactions, the ghost will have different chase animations, sounds and actions depending on the current stage of your game. 

[h3] It's pretty safe outside, isn't it?[/h3]
Some maps have a backyard which serves as a "safe zone" (but ghost can still chase you if it sees you going outside). Now, the door which leads to the backyard has a chance to be locked and prevent you from going outside, so you should plan you escape more carefully.

[h3] Interior objects [/h3]
As I said before, ghost can now throw some of the objects. In addition, it can now trigger actions across the house (like making carousel move etc). For now, this is available on the new map only.

[h4] That's not all! [/h4]
I've made a huge work to make AI work more stable. Some cool new features are being worked on right now and I will let you now a bit later!

[h1] Updated UI [/h1]

Here comes an updated UI system. The main menu has been tweaked a bit to fit all the three maps as well as the in-game UI has been revamped. Some animations were added to make interactions a bit smoother. 

[h1] Reworked Sounds [/h1]

Every item now has it's own sound on pickup. Also there was some work on making sounds feel realistic and positional. 

[h1] New interactions with objects [/h1]

It felt unnerving to interact with small buttons. Now, when you want to enter a code on a panel or interact with computers, you camera will zoom in to a specific object to make it easier to interact with it. While focused, you will interact with an object using you mouse. For now this feature is only available on the new map.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ZkjKSiX.png[/img]

[h1] Improved graphics [/h1]
A big focus was on improving the current graphics level and optimization. Also, the lighting has become more realistic and stable to make it look better and now that expensive.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/fhCVfc4.png[/img]

[h1] Hunt Event Update [/h1]

During hunt, there is now more actions that happen across the house.

[h1] Fixes [/h1]

And, of course. a lot of fixes has been made as well. Networking script has been improved to make it easier to connect to lobby.

[h1] Future plans [/h1]

[h2] PvP mode [/h2]

Cool, right? I'm working on a mode where a player can play as a ghost and hunt it's own friends.

[h2] Animations [/h2]

New animations like holding items, interactions with phone/laptops are also coming in the near future.

[h2] In Game Voice [/h2]

You will be able to communicate with your friends using in-game voice chat with positional audio, which means they won't hear you if you're far away. The ghost will be able to hear your voice so be careful.
 
[h1] Some of my words[/h1]

Just wanted to thank everyone. Without you, I would not be able to go this far. I always appreciate your feedback and will try to make this game even better. 
You're always welcomed in our [url=https://discord.gg/V7CxpnhxCx]Discord Server[/url]!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/kKbAZ8m.jpg[/img]

notes.title: MAJOR CONTENT UPDATE - PART I
notes.notes:
Hey! It definitely has been a while since the last content update. And now I'm here to introduce you new major changes that arrive along with the today's update. Let's go!

"Part I"..? Yes, this update will be split in two parts. The current one brings a lot of Quality Of Life features, model revamps, stability fixes and some overall changes. Stay tuned for future announces regarding the second part. 

By the way, don't forget that out community has a Discord server where you can share your thoughts about the game, suggest changes or simply talk with a developer. You're always welcome here! (image is the link)
[url=https://discord.gg/V7CxpnhxCx][img]https://i.imgur.com/nc8WhNW.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]Item Inspect[/h1]

You can now inspect an item in your hands in order to get a short description on it as well as rotate it around. Your character can give a useful tip regarding some of the items so don't miss the chance!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/wq9fb5i.png[/img]

[h2]New Character Models & Animations[/h2]

Today's update brings new character models. The newer models has a better bones system so some of the animations will perform smoother. 

You can now see how your partner holds a flashlight and looks around (head movement is now synced across all clients). This also fixes a problem when you couldn't see how your buddy moves his head while spectating.

[h1] New Ghost Kill Animation [/h1]

When you get caught by the entity, a new death animation will appear. "It" now appears in front of you to finish you off.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/v0S57QQ.png[/img]

[h1] Tutorial Scene [/h1] 

A new tutorial scene will show up upon first entering. it will teach you some basics like how to interact with environment and use devices like phones etc.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/8PBB2M1.png[/img]

[h1] Updated Items Models [/h1]

Some 3D models got a remodel to fit the current graphics level. Also almost every model has gotten improved textures for a proper lightning reflections.

[h1] Map Changes [/h1]

I've added some new interior/exterior changes that will mostly help you to navigate yourself. New lamps, street lights and new decorations.

Here are some of few examples:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/PDQvz6V.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/vRS1AQB.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/9x8ZxOQ.png[/img]

[h1] Updates User Interface [/h1]

The Revamped UI system will help to keep focus on the center of the screen. There are no more buttons in the corners. *Happy Widescreen monitor user noises*

The work on the UI system is not done yet, so expect new changes in the second part of the Update.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/j3UhTfr.png[/img]

[img]https://i.imgur.com/K70Mu4w.png[/img]

[h1] Lights On Brown's House [/h1]

Unlike the second map, the light switchers on Browns' House were inactive. Now, you can turn on room lights.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/iHjyCd7.png[/img]

[h1] Updated Controls [/h1]

New keyboard buttons were assigned for binds like switching flashlight, using device etc to make it more user friendly. I'm working on a customized binds so in the future expect changes.

[h1] Adjusted Pause Menu [/h1]

Some tweaks were made to pause menu. Lot of players did accidentally leave due to bad UI UX. There is now a confirmation window upon exit. And overall the interface is bigger and more clean.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/opID3Gq.png[/img]

[h1] The Upcoming New Map Details [/h1] 

The work on a new map is ongoing. I will share the progress a bit later as well as planned release date. So watch for the announcements!

[h1] Fixes [/h1]

[h3] - It was not possible to pickup item under a dead body [/h3]
[h3] - The spectator mouse movements were not synced correctly [/h3]
[h3] - Some door collisions could make you stuck [/h3]
[h3] - You now can't pick up items through the wall [/h3]
[h3] - Some items could disappear upon dropping [/h3]
[h3] - Major networking fixes [/h3]
[h3] - Optimised lights on all maps [/h3]

notes.title: Regular Update & Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hey there! Today's regular update will cover some of the existing issues and minor additions. Let's get to it!

[h3]New Achievements[/h3]

As of now, you will get different achievements for escaping maps on different difficulty. You will get 3 of them for each map (Easy, Normal, Nightmare).

[h3]Crucifix adjustments[/h3]

Crucifix was not working correctly, and now it will visibly corrupt for all of players on the server (there were some issues when hosts could not see the corrupted crucifix)

[h2]Other Changes[/h2]

- You could drop item under objects with no collisions resulting in item to disappear

- Players inventory now properly adjusted to FOV settings (it was too far when playing on high FOV)

- The garage keypad on Mansion now has a light indicator, so players can spot it a bit easier

- Brightness adjustments

- You could use Auto-Injector on car (lol)

- Tweaked ghost timings

- There was a small chance for 3rd player to not connect to the server

- Added some tips on items pickups

- Ghost will not corrupt crucifix if it can't harm you (for instance, if you collide with the ghost while it's standing and hasn't start the hunt yet)

- There was a problem when you couldn't pickup item from a dead teammate 

- Adjusted revive hitbox

- Fixed positions where you could clip out of map

notes.title: Items highlight, Steam Achievements, new Discord server and more!

Hey everyone! Today I'm happy to introduce you some cool features. Most of them are quality of life features, but that's not all! Lets get to it.

[h1]New Discord Server[/h1]
A bit late, but our community now has a Discord Server! You can share your thoughts about the game, suggest some new features or just simply ask a question! You are always welcome here and if you need me, I will always respond if I can (image is the link). 

[url=https://discord.gg/JaauwxEtYP][img]https://i.imgur.com/VmkDrS8.jpghttps://discord.gg/JaauwxEtYP[/img][/url]


[h1]Items Highlight[/h1]

A lot of people have been struggling with finding items. Today I present a Highlight Items feature, which will make it easier to find crucial items. This feature can be enabled/disabled in a lobby menu. Of course, for the realistic experience you must to turn this option off, however, if you launch a game with the Highlight Items option off, after 40 minutes you will be given a choice to enable it (in case you're stuck and can't find items).

[img]https://i.imgur.com/CM8gfUx.jpg[image][/img]

[h1]New Ghost event and behaviour adjustments[/h1]

Ghosts had some tweaks as well. They now have a new behaviour which will make them occasionally  wondering a house. Now, be aware of an unexpected meeting!

Also, I've adjusted AI pathfinding and make ghosts open doors. They can't open sealed doors (because you need a key obviously), and this will make you better understand the ghost current location. 

[h1]Steam Achievements[/h1]

Finally! Steam achievements are here! Can you complete them all?

[img]https://i.imgur.com/PcPFVpF.jpg[image][/img]

[h1]FOV slider[/h1]

Many felt uncomfortable with the current FOV, so now you can easily adjust it in the settings panel in main menu or in straight in an active game.

[h2]Downstreet Mansion Cinematic Trailer [/h2]

A bit too late, but if you didn't check out the new map cinematic trailer, it is the right time!

[previewyoutube=CmWJxdrwNMw;full][/previewyoutube]

____________________________________________________________

[h3]New crucifix model[/h3]
As people requested, the crucifix has now a damaged state. With each use it becomes more and more broken.

[h3]Interior adjustments on Browns' house[/h3]
Some changes were made in the first map to fill the interior spaces.

[h3]UI improvements[/h3]
Some changes were made on the UI components to make them more visible.

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
Many bugs were fixed and a lot of optimization work has been done.


I'm always there for you. Thank you for the support. Lets continue out way out of the Early Access!

notes.title: REVIVE SYSTEM IS HERE!
notes.notes:
[h1]Revive System[/h1]

Hey there! I'm happy to introduce you a new item! A medical [b]Auto-Injector[/b] will allow you to bring a fallen teammate back to life. Many have requested this feature, so here it is!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/1X2hOYw.png[/img]

You can revive your buddy couple times per game. This will allow you to stay together for a longer time.


[h1]Items Guide Panel[/h1]

Many players have been struggling because it's not always possible to look for tips in the upper left corner of the screen. So, here's a quick guide for what some items do to make your escape.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/MGxPdx4.png[/img]

This panel will show up on the first game start. But you always can access it when sitting in a lobby.

[h1]Balance Changes[/h1]

This update also bring some balance changes. The ghost was slightly nerfed on every parameter including speed, vision etc. Also, there were some brightness adjustments. The fog has been reduced and the flashlight range has also been increased. This will improve player experience during playthrough.

As always, thank you for your feedback. Let's make this game even better!

notes.title: NEW MAP IS RELEASED!
notes.notes:
[b][h1]Major Update![/h1][/b]

Here it is! A long awaited Major Update. I'm so excited to introduce you the new map - [b]The Downstreet Mansion[/b]. This map can take up to 3 players wish a possible increase in the future. The new map has it's own mystery, escape routes as well as new puzzles!

[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/43315763/dc1d308c9286e5c084a104a515c67bc771008db0.gif[/img]

[b][h1]A New Entity[/h1][/b]

Beware! A new entity has taken over the house. Each of them has it's own attributes so you should adapt and improvise on your escape. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/5epPCrg.png[/img]

[b][h1]Items[/h1][/b]

Also, I want to introduce you a brand new item - [b]Crucifix[/b]. It will allow you to excommunicate the entity while it's hunting you. However, you should not rely on it for too long, because each use decreases Crucifix efficiency.

There are actually a lot more new items, but they are unique for the new map. But the crucifix will be avaliable on all maps. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/Zk40upg.png[/img]

[b][h1]New Settings Panel[/h1][/b]

As requested, an extended version of settings has also arrived. You can now configure graphics settings as well as enable V-Sync

[img]https://i.imgur.com/BCZYL9I.png[/img]

[b][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][/b]

I've done a huge work on fixing bugs as well as network related issues. There is still huge work to be done, so I appreciate every your feedback in the discussion thread.

[b][h1]Community[/h1][/b]

I appreciate every feedback regarding the game, whether it's a bug related thing or just an opinion/suggestion. I will always listen to your desires and will try to implement every feature that will make this game better. Thank you!

notes.title: IT'S COMING!
notes.notes:
Long time no see, eh? Got some good news! The big content update will most likely arrive this friday. This update will include new items, some mechanics and the most awaited - a new map! The new map will feature 3 player COOP (might increase the cap later based on the feedback whether 3 players enough for that map) and the new entity.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/cmh6G9U.png[/img]

Also, with the new update you will be able to fight a ghost using a specific item. But that doesn't mean you are safe! You still should perform your runaway using hideouts and be as quiet as a mouse. 

[img]https://i.imgur.com/gWMfGwO.png[/img]

Can't tell more! You will figure everything out by yourself. Get yourself ready for the most exciting escape!
As always, thank you for your feedback. You are the reason this game can become better.

notes.title: New UI and detail on a new map
notes.notes:
Hey there! New Main Menu UI arriving today. I made a focus for several maps support.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/km9a9Qe.png[/img]

The hard work regarding the new map is still ongoing. I've managed to finish interior and exterior so far.
Here's a raw look on a new map:

[img]https://i.imgur.com/ffnfMWn.png[/img]

Quite big, isn't it? Yes, the map is about 3x bigger than the first one, and will feature one more additional player to play. Also, you will be hunted by a new ghost. I can't yet show or tell anything about the new entity, because there is still work to be done.

Thanks for contributing to this community. Wait for more news!
